name: Hero Banner WGACA
description: Main hero banner with optional text, ctas, and layout styles

attribute_definitions.name: Enable Container
attribute_definitions.description: Wrap hero banner in container, enabling this will restrict hero banner to max width

attribute_definitions.name: Hero Banner Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust spacing, alignment, or styling of the hero banner container. e.g. 'mb-2'. See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Content Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust spacing, alignment, or styling of the hero content. e.g. 'p-2'. See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Desktop Image
attribute_definitions.description: For faster load time, please use images under 500 KB.

attribute_definitions.name: Mobile Image
attribute_definitions.description: For faster load time, please use images under 500 KB.

attribute_definitions.name: Alt Text
attribute_definitions.description: The image alt text shown by the component.

attribute_definitions.name: Text and CTA Placement
attribute_definitions.description: Text and CTA Placement

attribute_definitions.name: Tablet/Mobile Text Position
values: Text below image on tablet and smaller
attribute_definitions.description: Defines how the text should be positioned relative to the image on smaller screens. Defaults to text overlaying the image.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Text Configurations
attribute_definition_groups.description: Configure text styling for title and subtitle elements, including font sizes, colors, alignment, width, and utility classes for layout and spacing on desktop.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Width
attribute_definitions.description: Set the width of hero content, eg: '25%'

attribute_definitions.name: Title Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust the styling, spacing, and alignment of the title. e.g. 'mb-2' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Title font size, default is 32px

attribute_definitions.name: Content Alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the content. Defaults to center.

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust the styling, spacing, and alignment of the subtitle. e.g. 'mb-2' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Subtitle font size, default is 18px

attribute_definitions.name: Button Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to adjust the styling, spacing, and alignment of the button. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Button Style
attribute_definitions.description: Select button styling, default is btn-primary

attribute_definitions.name: Tertiary Button Text Color
attribute_definitions.description: Specifies the text color for the tertiary button.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Tablet Configurations
attribute_definition_groups.description: Configure text styling for title and subtitle elements, including font sizes, colors, alignment, width, and utility classes for layout and spacing on tablet.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Width
attribute_definitions.description: Set the width of hero content on tablet, eg: '25%'

attribute_definitions.name: Content Background Color
attribute_definitions.description: Sets a background color for the hero content on tablet. Commonly used when the text is positioned below the image.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Sets title font size for tablets, default is 20px

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Sets subtitle font size font size for tablets, default is 16px

attribute_definitions.name: Tertiary Button Text Color
attribute_definitions.description: Specifies the text color for the tertiary button.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Mobile Configurations
attribute_definition_groups.description: Configure text styling for title and subtitle elements, including font sizes, colors, alignment, width, and utility classes for layout and spacing on mobile.

attribute_definitions.name: Content Background Color
attribute_definitions.description: Sets a background color for the hero content on mobile. Commonly used when the text is positioned below the image.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Sets title font size for mobile screens, default is 24px

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Font Size
attribute_definitions.description: Sets subtitle font size font size for mobile screens, default is 18px

attribute_definitions.name: Tertiary Button Text Color
attribute_definitions.description: Specifies the text color for the tertiary button.
